main_measure.name: mean of forecast x (5-day return - coin mean 5-day return), grid cases pooled
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 (positive) confirms, t <= -2 (negative) rejects, over at least 500 grid cases

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2 over at least 500 cases.
reading: All grid bars (positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window with a 5-bar return inside it) are cases, flat-forecast ones included, and the coin's mean 5-day return is the mean of its grid returns over all its windows.
